name: Ca ta ma
summary: Cá tà ma is a small deep-water fish from Lý Sơn and Bình Châu with soft, fragrant meat. Grill it with salt and chili and eat it with rice paper, herbs, and green chili salt.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the meat soft and fragrant.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: grill with salt and chili, fry, braise with turmeric, or cook a sour soup with lá giang. The grilled fish is eaten with rice paper, herbs, and green chili salt.
where: Deep water at Lý Sơn and Bình Châu.
seoTitle: Ca ta ma — grilled fish from Ly Son
seoDescription: Cá tà ma from Lý Sơn and Bình Châu, a soft deep-water fish grilled with salt and chili. From 250,000 VND a kilogram.
